findings.detail: E07 source count includes the separate December 31, 2024 schedule even though the reviewed report_date is December 31, 2025.

rationale: The raw filing explicitly has two consolidated schedules of investments: one as of December 31, 2025 and a separate comparative schedule as of December 31, 2024. The current schedule total is table 47 row 9 with fair value 1,512,098, while the comparative schedule total is table 69 row 38 with fair value 1,445,655. The source table structure also uses issuer rows plus investment-detail rows, as shown by AAH Topco at table 25 rows 28-29, so raw schedule rows are not a one-to-one position count. The E07 message source=775 vs output=422 is therefore consistent with the oracle source side counting comparative-period/current raw schedule lines, not evidence that 353 current 2025 holdings are missing from output.
